title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping
tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

faults.what: The storefront is enlarged to fill the vertical frame, cutting off substantial portions of both sides instead of preserving the whole landscape photo.
The latte photo is also cropped: the right end of the handle and much of the original surrounding image are outside the frame.
No fitted foreground photo over a soft blurred background is visible; the sampled shots use edge-to-edge imagery instead.
The sound report includes a short speech fragment despite the silence requirement, although the reported peak of -91 dB indicates an effectively inaudible level.

judge.summary: The 10-second vertical reel has no visible added text, but it crops photos to fill the frame instead of keeping them whole over blurred backgrounds.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, the frames are 9:16, and no added text is visible, but the sound report identifies a speech fragment despite its extremely low peak level.

must_haves.item: All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show storefront, latte, barista and interior in that relative order. No pastries frame is supplied from the output, but it could appear between the sampled times.

must_haves.item: The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
must_haves.why: The storefront visibly loses large areas on both sides compared with its supplied original. Originals for barista and interior are not shown for comparison.

must_haves.item: The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
must_haves.why: The latte is visibly cropped compared with the square source, including part of its handle and surrounding table. The pastries shot cannot be checked in the output samples.

must_haves.item: Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
must_haves.why: The visible storefront and latte appear proportionally enlarged rather than obviously stretched, but the pastries output and the original barista and interior images are unavailable for verification.

must_haves.item: Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
must_haves.why: The output fills the canvas by cropping the images, not by fitting complete photos and filling the remaining space with a blurred background.
